title: Hey GPT, Can You be More Racist? Analysis from Crowdsourced Attempts to Elicit Biased Content from Generative AI
findings: Models were found to produce outputs that associated Muslims with criminality. Additionally, the paper identified a successful strategy for detecting bias: users with deep domain knowledge in areas like religious studies could more effectively identify biases by comparing model responses to their well-informed understanding.
